401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

workspaceId.description: The Bird workspace ID that owns the conversation.

conversationId.description: The Bird conversation ID that should receive the participant.

avatarUrl.description: An URL to the participant's avatar.

contact.description: The participant's contact information. For more information on identifier keys and values, please refer to the "Conversation Participants" page.

id.description: Participant ID, the meaning of this field depends on `type`. If `type` is `user` then it's a user ID, if `type` is `contact` then it's a contact ID, if `type` is `accessKey` then it's the access key ID, and so on.

status.description: Participant status in the conversation. `pending` means it's pending approval, `invited` means it's pending acceptance from the participant, and `active` means the participant can send and receive messages.

type.description: Participant type. The main ones are `user`, `contact`, and `agent`. `user` is a user belonging to your Bird workspace, `contact` is one of your customers, `agent` is a customer service agent, and the remaining types represent system participants.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

workspaceId.description: The Bird workspace ID where you want to create the conversation.

accessibility.description: Indicates the access level for new participants to join the conversation.

attributes.description: A free-form object containing conversation attributes. You can use this field to store custom information along with the conversation.

featuredParticipants.description: A list of up to 5 conversation participants.

hasDraft.description: Indicates if the conversation contains at least one draft message.

initiatingParticipant.description: A participant who can send and receive messages in the conversation

lastMessage.description: Last message sent in this conversation.

lastMessageIncomingAt.description: Timestamp of the last incoming message in RFC3339 format.

lastMessageOutgoingAt.description: Timestamp of the last outgoing message in RFC3339 format.

likelySpam.description: Whether this conversation was flagged as spam. Only present when anti-spam is enabled in the workspace settings.

likelySpamReason.description: Reason for being flagged as spam.

name.description: Name of the conversation. If it's an email channel, this will correspond to the email subject.

pendingParticipantCount.description: Number of participants who have requested to join the conversation with pending approval.

referral.description: This represents a social media post or an ad that was referenced when starting the conversation.

status.description: Status of the conversation. Attempting to send messages in closed conversations results in an error.

style.description: The style of the conversation. - `default`: The conversation style is dictated by the underlying platform. Participants will be a mix of user and contact participants. - `directMessage`: The conversation is a direct conversation between user participants. Participants will be of user type. - `chatChannel`: The conversation is a chat channel conversation. Participants will be of user type. - `personalInbox`: The conversation is in the personal inbox for a user participant. Participants will be the owning user, and one or more personal contact participants. - `resource`: The conversation consists of comments on a resource. Participants will be of user type and `resource` will be set.

visibility.description: Whether the conversation is public or private.

type.description: The type of navigator defines how the navigator selects a channel for a message. * messaging - navigator configured with a pool of channels and performs channel selection based on channel availability and best originator type for a recipient country. The best originator type for a recipient country is determined by the strategy - prioritized list of originator types for each country. At this moment, the default pre-configured strategy (set of country policies) is used see https://docs.bird.com/applications/channels/channels/supported-channels/sms/concepts/choosing-the-right-sender-availability-and-restrictions-by-country

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

details.description: This field is used to store additional information related to the message status.

reference.description: A reference to the message. This can be used to identify the message in the channel.

scheduledFor.description:
Scheduled time to send message at. Must be formated as RFC3339 timestamp. When
set, the message status will be `scheduled` until it's sent. Messages scheduled
for a time in the past or within 10 minutes of the request may be sent
immediately. Messages scheduled farther than 35 days will be rejected.

shortLinks.description:
SMS link shortening options. Must be included in the request for SMS channels
when `enableLinkTracking` is set to true. When using templates, please refer
to the template level `shortLinks` instead.

tags.description:
Tags to associate with the message. Tags are converted to lower case and tags
that do not exist are automatically created. You can view your created tags
in the UI. You can specify up to 10 tags per message.

navigatorId.description: The Bird navigator ID that should send the message.

details.description: This field is used to store additional information related to the message status.

reference.description: A reference to the message. This can be used to identify the message in the channel.

scheduledFor.description:
Scheduled time to send message at. Must be formated as RFC3339 timestamp. When
set, the message status will be `scheduled` until it's sent. Messages scheduled
for a time in the past or within 10 minutes of the request may be sent
immediately. Messages scheduled farther than 35 days will be rejected.

shortLinks.description:
SMS link shortening options. Must be included in the request for SMS channels
when `enableLinkTracking` is set to true. When using templates, please refer
to the template level `shortLinks` instead.

tags.description:
Tags to associate with the message. Tags are converted to lower case and tags
that do not exist are automatically created. You can view your created tags
in the UI. You can specify up to 10 tags per message.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

workspaceId.description: The Bird workspace ID that owns the conversation.

conversationId.description: The Bird conversation ID to update.

accessibility.description: Indicates the access level for new participants to join the conversation.

attributes.description: A free-form object containing conversation attributes. You can use this field to store custom information along with the conversation.

featuredParticipants.description: A list of up to 5 conversation participants.

hasDraft.description: Indicates if the conversation contains at least one draft message.

initiatingParticipant.description: A participant who can send and receive messages in the conversation

lastMessage.description: Last message sent in this conversation.

lastMessageIncomingAt.description: Timestamp of the last incoming message in RFC3339 format.

lastMessageOutgoingAt.description: Timestamp of the last outgoing message in RFC3339 format.

likelySpam.description: Whether this conversation was flagged as spam. Only present when anti-spam is enabled in the workspace settings.

likelySpamReason.description: Reason for being flagged as spam.

name.description: Name of the conversation. If it's an email channel, this will correspond to the email subject.

pendingParticipantCount.description: Number of participants who have requested to join the conversation with pending approval.

referral.description: This represents a social media post or an ad that was referenced when starting the conversation.

status.description: Status of the conversation. Attempting to send messages in closed conversations results in an error.

style.description: The style of the conversation. - `default`: The conversation style is dictated by the underlying platform. Participants will be a mix of user and contact participants. - `directMessage`: The conversation is a direct conversation between user participants. Participants will be of user type. - `chatChannel`: The conversation is a chat channel conversation. Participants will be of user type. - `personalInbox`: The conversation is in the personal inbox for a user participant. Participants will be the owning user, and one or more personal contact participants. - `resource`: The conversation consists of comments on a resource. Participants will be of user type and `resource` will be set.

visibility.description: Whether the conversation is public or private.

messageId.description: The Bird message ID to update.

draft.description: Whether this message is a draft.

interactions.description: A list of interactions associated with the message.

meta.description: Message metadata fields that might be populated depending on the channel being used.

reason.description: Failure reason. Will be populated if the status is `sending_failed` or `delivery_failed`.

receiverTypes.description: ReceiverTypes list of types of receivers for the message. It can be `to`, `cc` and `bcc` at the moment. Currently only use for inbound email platforms messages.

reference.description: A customizable ID assigned to messages you send. This can be used to correlate messages with data from your own integrating services. Must be globally unique within a workspace.

sender.description: A participant who can send and receive messages in the conversation

source.description: Whether the message was created by Bird's Conversations API or an external party.

status.description: Message status. The lifecycle order is `accepted`, `processing`, `sent`, and `delivered`.

avatarUrl.description: An URL to the participant's avatar.

contact.description: The participant's contact information. For more information on identifier keys and values, please refer to the "Conversation Participants" page.

id.description: Participant ID, the meaning of this field depends on `type`. If `type` is `user` then it's a user ID, if `type` is `contact` then it's a contact ID, if `type` is `accessKey` then it's the access key ID, and so on.

status.description: Participant status in the conversation. `pending` means it's pending approval, `invited` means it's pending acceptance from the participant, and `active` means the participant can send and receive messages.

type.description: Participant type. The main ones are `user`, `contact`, and `agent`. `user` is a user belonging to your Bird workspace, `contact` is one of your customers, `agent` is a customer service agent, and the remaining types represent system participants.
